skill.name: bulk-enrich-csv
skill.description: Use Leadsets to add current job titles, company details, and available work emails to contact spreadsheets. Check usage before each batch and group results by email status.
skill.summary: Enrich contact spreadsheets in batches and separate verified work emails from results that need review.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The shell, environment, and reconnaissance alerts are false positives from Markdown and ordinary API or output instructions. The documented Leadsets connection sends contact identifiers without requiring a specific approval step before the first lookup. The export steps also lack explicit safeguards against spreadsheet formula interpretation.

remediation.issue: Contact identifiers can reach Leadsets before the user approves the transfer.
remediation.suggestion: Show the destination, selected rows, and identifier fields. Require approval before any probe, batch, or asynchronous submission, and send only the fields needed for matching.

remediation.issue: Spreadsheet exports do not specify how to keep untrusted values from becoming formulas.
remediation.suggestion: Write untrusted cells as literal text in Sheets and Excel. Use a formula-safe CSV export policy for both input columns and values returned by Leadsets.

content.value_statement: Contact spreadsheets often have missing work emails and outdated job titles. Use Leadsets to update matching rows in batches and separate verified addresses from records that need review.
actual_capabilities: Read CSV, Excel, and Google Sheets data that the agent can access.
Identify exact duplicates and mark rows that lack a usable lookup identifier.
Check Leadsets usage before each batch and save a resume point after completed batches.
Look up current titles, company details, and available work emails for matching contacts.
Append status columns to an enriched copy and flag possible company changes.
Group results into verified, catch-all, and review segments.
limitations: Requires a Leadsets account and either a configured MCP connection or an API key.
Rows without usable identifiers or matching records may not receive enrichment data.
Service quotas can pause a run and leave rows pending.
Does not run a separate verification pass on existing emails or write results back to a CRM.

use_cases.title: Prepare a CRM Import
use_cases.description: Refresh titles and employers in an old export, and review company changes before importing the copy.

use_cases.title: Review an Event Contact List
use_cases.description: Add available work emails to an approved event export and separate confirmed addresses from uncertain matches.

use_cases.title: Process a Large Client Spreadsheet
use_cases.description: Plan batches against the account allowance and document where to resume when a quota pauses the run.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Contact CSV
prompt_templates.scenario: First run with a new CSV
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this CSV without sending any rows to Leadsets. Identify the lookup columns and count eligible rows, duplicates, and rows without usable identifiers.

prompt_templates.title: Test One Contact Lookup
prompt_templates.scenario: Confirm that the selected columns identify the right contact
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Leadsets to look up only the first eligible row using its name and company domain. Report the matched company and email status, then stop.

prompt_templates.title: Fill Missing Emails in Excel
prompt_templates.scenario: Process a defined subset of an approved workbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Enrich only rows with blank work emails in this approved workbook. Check usage before each batch and create a separate copy with email status and company changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Quota-Limited Sheets Run
prompt_templates.scenario: Handle a large list with a fixed record budget
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan this Google Sheets run using the current Leadsets allowance and wait for my approval before sending contact data. Keep the original sheet unchanged and write results to a private copy. If a limit pauses the run, report the pending count, last completed row ID, and reset time if available.

output_examples.input: Enrich an approved CSV of 20 contacts using their names and company domains.
output: The output copy retains all 20 rows. It marks two duplicates, one row without an identifier, and three unmatched contacts.
Of the 14 enriched contacts, 10 have verified addresses, two have catch-all addresses, and two need review.

output_examples.input: Process an approved Google Sheet and pause when the current allowance runs out.
output: The run completed 100 of 150 eligible rows. The other 50 are marked pending in the output copy.
The run stopped after row ID 100. The service reports a reset at 16:00 UTC.

best_practices: Confirm the provider and approved identifier fields before sending any rows, including the test row.
Check that the test match belongs to the intended person and company before starting the batch.
Keep the enriched copy private and review uncertain matches and company changes before sharing or importing it.
anti_patterns: Do not submit an entire contact list when only a small subset needs enrichment.
Do not treat a catch-all or unknown address as verified or assume verification grants permission to send messages.
Do not restart a paused run from the beginning when a saved resume point is available.

faq.question: Which file formats can I use?
faq.answer: Use a CSV, an Excel file, or a Google Sheet that your agent can read.

faq.question: What identifiers can I provide?
faq.answer: Use a LinkedIn profile URL or a full name with a company name or domain. A work email can also identify a contact when refreshing role and company.

faq.question: Does contact data leave my spreadsheet?
faq.answer: Yes. The agent sends lookup identifiers to Leadsets to match contacts.

faq.question: What happens when a quota is reached?
faq.answer: The skill can save completed work, mark remaining rows pending, and report the resume point and any reset time provided by Leadsets.

faq.question: Will the skill change my original file?
faq.answer: By default it creates an enriched copy. For Google Sheets, you can also request new tabs without changing the original data.

faq.question: Are all returned addresses verified?
faq.answer: No. Only results explicitly marked verified belong in the verified segment. Catch-all and unknown results are kept separate.
